stopping_rule.canonical_publication_note: cannot actually be eliminated because the 48,000,909-byte artifact must still be written; B0129 and B0131 already measured 7.5/7.8 percent publication ceilings on comparable direct endpoints and stopped
stopping_rule.validation_placement_preflight_note: B0054 measured this partition as necessary process-level CUDA device/profile discovery plus initial memory-budget placement; B0108 prototyped bypassing it, saved only 3.636364 percent, and observed startup moving between placement subphases rather than disappearing
stopping_rule.structural_observation: the startup partition is roughly fixed in absolute terms, so it necessarily dominates a sub-half-second endpoint; it is a shared limiter of every small direct route rather than anything specific to count seven, and it is already closed by prior measurement
stopping_rule.conclusion: sufficiently optimized for now; no independent reusable 5-10 percent component is identified
